package: SMD 10 pads, 5 x 7 mm, 1.27 mm pitch
kicad_symbol: Sensor_Gas:MiCS-5524 (pins C Rh1, D Rs1, F Rh2, G Rs2, others NC: CONFIRMED against the pin table p4)
kicad_footprint: Sensor:Sensortech_MiCS_5x7mm_P1.25mm (data sheet gives 1.27 mm pitch 4 x 1.27 = 5.08: check the KiCad pitch)

pins.name: Rh1
pins.net: heater low side -> GND (heater fed from the switch)

circuit.role: heater switch: load switch from +3V3, ON from the expander [this design]
heater series resistor for 3.3 V (data sheet uses 82 ohm from 5 V, p3) [this design]
circuit.page: p3: VH 2.4 V, 32 mA, RH 66-82 ohm, PH max 88 mW
p3 measurement circuit uses 5 V; this design uses the 1.8 V ADC reference so the reading is ratiometric and can never exceed the ADC range

supplies.heater: 32 mA, 76 mW (71-81) at VH 2.4 V; abs max 88 mW (p3)
supplies.Vsupply_spec: 4.9-5.1 V with the 82 ohm resistor (p3); this design uses 3.3 V with 30 ohm
supplies.heater_3V3_check: 30 ohm: nominal VH = 3.3*74/104 = 2.35 V, 74 mW; worst case 3.4 V and RH 66 ohm: 2.34 V, 83 mW (< 88). 27 ohm would reach 88 mW at the corners.

logic: Analogue only. AIN_GAS = 1.8 V * RLOAD / (RLOAD + Rs). Rs in clean air 100k-1.5M (p2) -> 0.05-0.58 V; Rs falls in reducing gas (S60 = 1.2-50 at 60 ppm CO) -> towards 1.8 V.
placement: Gas vent, but its own corner: the heater runs at 76 mW continuously; keep it away from the SHT40/STCC4 and SGP41/BME690 (heat and its own outgassing) and from the battery.
SGX: sensor must sit behind a filter (membrane) protecting it from water and dust (p2). Keep away from silicone adhesives/vapours (poisoning, p2).
Reflow in neutral atmosphere without flux vapours (p2): fit in the last reflow pass.
notes: The heater is the dominant load of the whole sensor set when on (about 106 mW from 3.3 V including the resistor): switch it, and let firmware run it in bursts (warm-up time [mem]: minutes for a stable baseline).

Heater (C-F) and sensing layer (D-G) are separate pins (p4); the data sheet ties F and G to the same 5 V. Feeding them from different rails (3.3 V heater, 1.8 V sense) assumes the two are isolated on the die [interpretation].
Not selective: reacts to CO, ethanol, hydrogen, ammonia, methane (p1).
unverified: Electrical isolation between heater and sense layer.
